properties.findings: closure3 run: 9 passed, 0 failed (after the epoch fixture moved to plan_epoch; add_epoch records an arrived point, and the report reads an absent status as arrived).
properties.name: No declared criterion reads as no criterion stated, never a default; an unknown leg is refused by name; traceability at 100 closes on a delivered thread and opens when the check fails; a counted leg with nothing to run on cannot read as closed; 50% is a legal declaration; a budget inside its limit but not its margin is a hole; the first hole follows the declared order; scheduled work governed by an open decision is the decisions hole; closure is a report and the release report carries it
